=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:63 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `MISSING_LOG_ARCHIVE_MARKERS` is defined but never used, while `_is_missing_log_archive_message()` hardcodes equivalent logic.
  WHY: This is dead code and a maintenance hazard because the constant does not affect behavior; reviewers agree on low severity.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:695-700 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `_is_retryable_log_archive_message()` does not treat HTTP 429 rate-limit responses as retryable.
  WHY: The function filters out numeric markers and the regex only matches 502/503/504, so transient rate limits fail immediately instead of retrying; all reviewers agree, and the severity is medium.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:737-738 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `_build_missing_log_archive_error()` is called with the full message, which can duplicate endpoint information already included in the formatted error.
  WHY: This produces noisier, harder-to-parse error output; reviewers agree on low severity and note the helper exists to extract cleaner detail.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:741-743 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop performs real `time.sleep()` backoff during missing-archive and transient-failure retries.
  WHY: This adds wall-clock delay in production and directly slows tests that exercise the 404 path; reviewers consistently rate it low severity.
- tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py:941-1092 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `test_main_missing_log_archive_soft_fails_and_dedupes_attempts` incurs real retry backoff delays.
  WHY: The test drives the production retry path and therefore waits through the backoff sleeps, increasing CI runtime; all reviewers agree this is a low-severity test latency issue.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:695-700 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: HTTP 429 (rate limit) errors are not treated as retryable.
  WHY: The function filters out numeric markers from `RETRY_MARKERS` and regex only matches 502/503/504.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:737 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Full exception message passed as detail parameter, duplicating endpoint information in final error string.
  WHY: Error logs become noisier and harder to parse, with endpoint appearing twice in the error message.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:743 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Missing-log-archive (404) retries incur real backoff sleeps even for persistent 404s.
  WHY: Increases collection runtime and CI test execution time unnecessarily for cases where 404 is persistent (log truly missing).
- tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py:1076 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Integration test incurs real sleep delays (1s + 2s for persistent 404) due to production backoff logic.
  WHY: Slows down test suite execution significantly, especially when test suite runs multiple times.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:63 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `MISSING_LOG_ARCHIVE_MARKERS = ("404", "not found")` is defined but never used anywhere in the module.
  WHY: `_is_missing_log_archive_message()` uses hardcoded "not found" and a 404 regex instead of the constant.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:696-701 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_is_retryable_log_archive_message()` filters out all numeric `RETRY_MARKERS` and its regex only matches 502/503/504, so GitHub API 429 responses are not retryable.
  WHY: When the GitHub API rate-limits a log archive fetch, the collector will immediately fail instead of retrying after a backoff.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:704-707, 738 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_build_missing_log_archive_error(repo, run_id, endpoint, detail)` includes `endpoint={endpoint}`, and the call site passes the full exception message as `detail`, causing duplicate endpoint information.
  WHY: The helper `_extract_log_archive_error_detail` exists to extract a clean detail from the message; using it would produce clearer errors.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:743 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On retryable failures, the loop executes `time.sleep(LOG_ARCHIVE_FETCH_BACKOFF_SECONDS * attempt)` between attempts.
  WHY: In production this adds wall-clock delay, and it also slows tests that intentionally trigger the 404 path.
- tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py:941-1092 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test intentionally triggers a 404 and therefore incurs real sleep cost through the production retry loop.
  WHY: It slows down CI unnecessarily and should verify retry semantics without paying real-time penalties.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
